title: Foundation Movement Recording Roadmap
purpose: Collect paired front + side MoveNet evidence for each foundational movement. Front view captures left/right symmetry and lateral mechanics; side view captures depth, hinge, root travel and floor transitions. Animation/FBX evidence later supplies true 3D bone/root rotation that MoveNet cannot directly observe.

statusMeaning.CAPTURED_FRONT: Front-view MoveNet evidence exists for the primary Lego block.
statusMeaning.CAPTURED_SIDE: Side-view MoveNet evidence exists for the primary Lego block.
statusMeaning.PAIRED_2D_COMPLETE: Both front and side MoveNet evidence exist. This is still evidence, not validation or READY status.
statusMeaning.NEEDS_CAPTURE: At least one required view is still missing.

captureRules: Front + side are required for every Foundation movement unless a future reviewed exception explicitly says otherwise.
Keep the full body, including both feet and both hands, visible whenever the movement allows it.
Record the FRONT view first, save it, rotate about 90 degrees, then record the SIDE view.
Use controlled repetitions before fast repetitions so phase changes and pose checkpoints are easy to study.
The recorder generates reviewable skeleton pose checkpoints from captured frames; these are 2D pose references, not true 3D bone rotations.
Export important JSON evidence after the session. Browser-local evidence is bounded and is not the permanent reviewed motion library.
A paired capture supplies 2D evidence only. Canonical Lego status still requires study/review, while depth-axis rotation requires animation/FBX or another 3D source.

foundationSession.label: Foundation 8 — Paired Views
foundationSession.description: Eight high-value movements, each captured from front and side, giving PocketPT a stronger two-view perception foundation before 3D animation evidence is added.

tasks.label: Standing Baseline
tasks.repetitions: Hold a relaxed athletic stance for about 3 seconds, then make one small weight shift left and right.
tasks.frontGuidance: Face the camera squarely; keep shoulders, hips, knees and ankles visible.
tasks.sideGuidance: Turn about 90 degrees; keep head, shoulders, hips, knees and feet visible.

tasks.label: Slow Bodyweight Squat
tasks.repetitions: Perform 3 slow squats. Pause briefly at the bottom of each rep.
tasks.frontGuidance: Show stance width, knee tracking and left/right symmetry.
tasks.sideGuidance: Show hip depth, torso angle, knee flexion and root descent.

tasks.label: Forward Lunge — Both Sides
tasks.repetitions: Perform 2 controlled forward lunges with the left leg and 2 with the right leg.
tasks.frontGuidance: Show left/right step separation, knee tracking and hip shift.
tasks.sideGuidance: Show stride depth, front-knee angle, torso lean and rear-leg position.

tasks.label: Vertical Jump + Landing
tasks.repetitions: Perform 3 controlled vertical jumps. Reset fully between jumps and finish each landing before the next takeoff.
tasks.frontGuidance: Show bilateral symmetry, arm path and landing width.
tasks.sideGuidance: Show loading depth, takeoff, airborne rise and landing compression.

tasks.label: Stand → Ground / Plank Entry
tasks.repetitions: Perform 2 to 3 controlled stand-to-plank walkouts. Move slowly enough that hands-down, weight-transfer and plank-acquire phases are visible.
tasks.recordingLabel: foundation stand to ground plank entry
tasks.frontGuidance: Show hand placement, left/right weight transfer and foot symmetry.
tasks.sideGuidance: Show root descent, torso rotation toward horizontal and plank acquisition.

tasks.label: Ground / Plank → Stand
tasks.repetitions: From plank, perform 2 to 3 controlled walk-ins back to standing. Finish completely upright before repeating.
tasks.frontGuidance: Show hand/foot symmetry and left/right recovery pattern.
tasks.sideGuidance: Show horizontal-to-upright body-axis change, root rise and standing reacquisition.

tasks.label: Slow Push-Up Cycle
tasks.repetitions: Perform 3 slow push-ups. Pause briefly at the bottom and lock out clearly at the top.
tasks.frontGuidance: Show hand width, shoulder symmetry and left/right elbow behavior.
tasks.sideGuidance: Show top, lowering, bottom, rising and return with full body alignment visible.

tasks.label: Alternating Knee Drive / Mountain Climber
tasks.repetitions: From plank, perform 4 controlled knee drives per side. Keep the first set slow and symmetrical.
tasks.frontGuidance: Show left/right knee path, hip shift and alternating rhythm.
tasks.sideGuidance: Show knee-to-torso travel, plank support and trunk movement through each drive.
